name: Kuno Kastenangst
personality: He guards the goal as if every puck were an unannounced inspection.
visual_intent: Bulky pear ink blob, two giant startled white eyes and tiny wavering toothless mouth; old soft green cap, cream knit collar; huge vintage brown leather goalie catcher glove held open, small wire goalie mask carried LOW at other side completely away from face
biography: He guards the goal as if every puck were an unannounced inspection. In HyperNorm he classifies arrivals as stopped or regrettable. The glove catches complaints; the mask is carried aside so he can see the complainants. A dissonant card suggests that leaving a doorway open could also be a save. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Er hält den Kasten dicht. Für Besucher wurde ein anderes Problem eingerichtet.

name: Berta Bandeisen
personality: She considers the blue line a perfectly reasonable place to end a conversation.
visual_intent: Wide short squared scalloped ink blob, modest lashes under one heavy lifted brow, tightly closed stubborn side-frown; tiny cream-green shoulder cape; one short thick wooden hockey stick held upright beside body, curved blade fully inside cell, taped grip
biography: She considers the blue line a perfectly reasonable place to end a conversation. She patrols the corridor's imaginary blue line with a wooden stick and a firm sense of jurisdiction. Everything is either onside or somebody else's fault. She occasionally moves the line to let an exhausted neighbour pass. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Grenze ist eindeutig. Ihre Lage bleibt Verhandlungssache.

name: Nils Nullpunkt
personality: He organises every face-off around his personal need to be right.
visual_intent: Tall tapered curving ink blob, sharp confident sideways eyes, delighted asymmetrical open three-upper-tooth grin; green headband, tiny cream collar; balances one chunky black hockey puck flat in open goo palm, other hand directing sideways
biography: He organises every face-off around his personal need to be right. He directs courtyard play while presenting the puck as evidence that the centre must belong to someone. An ambiguous card asks whether a team can move without a central authority. He has started passing before finishing his explanation. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Er ist der Mittelpunkt. Die anderen werden entsprechend verschoben.

name: Fredo Frostlauf
personality: He is ready to accelerate as soon as somebody explains which way.
visual_intent: Narrow leaning but upright comma blob, curled crest, huge worried upward glance, inward-sucked toothless lips; small green neckerchief; holds ONE worn leather ice skate by its laces as lucky charm, no feet or legs
biography: He is ready to accelerate as soon as somebody explains which way. He carries the skate as a promise that one day the route will become obvious. The building divides residents into advancing and obstructing. A dissonant card has made him consider that waiting for a neighbour might count as movement. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Schlittschuh ist bereit. Die Richtung ist noch im Verfahren.

name: Ida Eisbrecher
personality: She scores chiefly to interrupt the captain's speech.
visual_intent: Round star-lobed ink blob, long side quiff, lively lashed eyes and impish crooked CLOSED smile; tiny green jersey patch and cream wrist wrap; holds compact wooden stick diagonally against flank and one puck in free hand, props not across face
biography: She scores chiefly to interrupt the captain's speech. Her puck is a portable interruption to compulsory team briefings. She divides announcements into useful and still going. When a contradictory card proposes listening, she offers the quiet residents the first turn to speak. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie verkürzt die Ansprache. Meist durch ein Tor.

name: Boris Strafminute
personality: He serves every penalty with the dignity of a wrongly filed invoice.
visual_intent: Very broad tall domed blob, one drooping crest, exhausted half-lidded eyes and wide open indignant bark with two upper teeth; green wool collar, patched leather elbow pad; holds squat brass egg timer, free hand palm up demanding explanation
biography: He serves every penalty with the dignity of a wrongly filed invoice. He measures his penalty with a little brass timer and sorts everyone into innocent or insufficiently informed. The building keeps adding minutes for disputing the count. He secretly uses some of them to hear a neighbour's side. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Strafzeit läuft. Eine Begründung wurde aus Zeitgründen vertagt.
